end.parentNote: Ira practised reading slopes and areas from motion graphs. They correctly used slope to find velocity and acceleration, and area under a velocity-time graph to find distance. At first, they linked a faster part with a steeper velocity-time line; this was clarified later by distinguishing higher velocity from greater acceleration. At home, ask them to explain one graph as a motion story in words.
